subject: S23-G: link-only sources row for HHS (HIPAA/OCR), OHRP (Common Rule) and FDA (IND/IRB, 21 CFR 50/56)?
body: Research-ethics (17.09) and law (18.02) sections need further-reading links to hhs.gov/hipaa, hhs.gov/ohrp and fda.gov pages. config/sources.yaml has no row for them (cdc-guidelines/ahrq don't fit). Proposal: add one link-only row 'us-federal-regulations' (HHS, OHRP, FDA, CMS, eCFR pages; public-domain-us-gov presumed, allow_copy false, link-only like uspstf). I won't edit sources.yaml myself; until you decide I'll keep those links out (StatPearls/AHRQ/CDC only) and add them once the row exists. Also OK for you to name it differently.
